title: Nondeterministic space inclusion
statement: Every language decidable by a finite nondeterministic Turing machine using space at most a constant multiple of $n^c+1$ for some $c\in\mathbb{N}$ belongs to $	ext{PSPACE}$, the union over $d\in\mathbb{N}$ of deterministic space classes using at most a constant multiple of $n^d+1$.
